name: blueprint_catalog_resolve_schedule
notes: Schedule-template placeholder fill (blueprint_catalog_helpers.c::blueprint_catalog_resolve_schedule vs LIVE cron/blueprint_catalog.py::_resolve_schedule). Covers: free-text passthrough, time validation (missing/invalid/range), weekday presets, day names, interval_min, verbatim remaining-slot fill, substitution. Dropped inputs (documented C/LIVE divergences, not traced): non-canonical times like '9:5' (C sscanf accepts, LIVE regex rejects); '+5'/'  5' interval values (strtol accepts, isdigit rejects); templates with unfilled placeholders (C leaves them verbatim, LIVE raises BlueprintFillError); non-string slot values (C only fills strings). LIVE raises BlueprintFillError where the port returns NULL — both trace as value 'ERROR'.
